description: Read the fleet: map id and version, the handoff points (AS/RS ports and stations), every robot with its connection, PackML state (IDLE, EXECUTE, SUSPENDED = charging, HELD = a blocking error, STOPPED = offline or stale), battery, node and errors, and the capacity counts. Read-only; an unknown fleet fails with fleet-not-found.
name: get_fleet

description: Read one leg: container, from and to handoff points, status, the robot executing it, and once failed the reason (CANCELLED, ROBOT_BLOCKED, ROBOT_FAULT, ROBOT_OFFLINE, ORDER_REJECTED, PICK_FAILED, DROP_FAILED, MAP_VERSION_RETIRED) with the robot's errorType. Read-only; an unknown fleet fails with fleet-not-found, an unknown leg with leg-not-found.
name: get_leg

description: Read one robot of the registry: connection, PackML state, battery, charging, availability, the node it stands on, its mission, its active error types, when it last reported, and its factsheet. Read-only; an unknown fleet fails with fleet-not-found, a robot not seen yet with robot-not-found (a robot appears on its first report, so a later read may find it).

manufacturer.description: the robot's VDA 5050 manufacturer, e.g. EMU

serialNumber.description: the robot's VDA 5050 serial number, e.g. R1

name: get_robot

description: List the fleet's open legs (QUEUED, ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP, CANCEL_REQUESTED) in acceptance order, each the same shape as get_leg. Internal charge and park missions are not legs. Read-only; an unknown fleet fails with fleet-not-found (never an empty list).
name: list_open_legs
